status_note: All 77 imports, 45 surface studies, 12 static prototypes and five galleries completed editor validation; verification.json is authoritative. Source fidelity is first-pass only, not final art approval.

material_contract.reference_mode: Unlit, two-sided, opaque RGB through Emissive; original baked background retained.
material_contract.surface_mode: SourceColor to BaseColor, roughness scalar 0.88; lit opaque source-color study.
material_contract.texture_color_space: sRGB for all imported color references
material_contract.new_mesh_materials: Vertex-colored static geometry via meshkit; source PNG not projected onto model.

showcase_maps.purpose: All 77 original images on boards with preserved image aspect ratios.
All 45 surface color studies; no claim of authored full PBR sets.
Five new source-guided architectural/prop static meshes.
Seven static maquettes: three creatures, player, ranger and two item props.
16 selected existing environmental mesh examples. Per-image link means family review destination, not that every candidate variant is placed or matches the image.

new_meshes.notes: Stepped clay gable, front dormer, stone chimney, teal windows, entry steps.
Two-storey timber hall, central clock and open belfry, golden bell, arched entry.
Seven teal/cream canopy stripes, paired counters, produce, hanging shop token.
Right pointing timber arrow with recessed blank face, iron bands and mossy footing.
Hanging lantern on timber bracket, linked chain, stepped iron cap, amber panes.
Three asymmetric leaf shoots; static maquette.
Two pointed ears, cream muzzle and golden horn; static maquette.
Round stepped silhouette, fins and coral cheeks; static maquette.
Single front/back interpretation; static maquette, no atlas animation.
Silver bob, teal long coat, cream scarf, ochre satchel; static maquette.
Physical prop interpretation of UI item icon; opaque palette.
Physical prop interpretation of UI item icon; opaque faceted gold.
